Class UIControllerBase

The wrapper class for anything that controls the logic of an UIView or a class that inherits from UIView. There can be multiple UIController using the same UIDocument. Example the main menu has sub UIView that display a specific menu like inventory, options, and ect. Depending on the submenu it might have its own UIController class for its logic.
